about.headline: Skincare shouldn't mean starting over
about.intro: Eloria was born from a simple idea: why ask a woman to give up the cream she loves just to improve the look of her skin? We made a booster serum that adds the power — it doesn't replace it.
about.story_title: It started from a real need
about.story_p1: We noticed most radiance products are either heavy, irritating, or force you to change your whole routine. The result: a shelf full of half-used products.
about.story_p2: So we developed a concentrated formula at studied concentrations — Tranexamic Acid, Niacinamide, and Glutathione — that blends into any moisturizer and turns it into a gentle even-tone serum, fragrance-free and alcohol-free.
about.values_title: Three values we won't compromise on
about.v1_d: A formula safe for sensitive skin, free of fragrance and alcohol, with a balanced pH of 5–6.
about.v2_d: Active ingredients at real concentrations that improve the look of pigmentation and even the look of tone gradually.
about.v3_d: We show you every ingredient and its percentage clearly. No overblown promises — just science and honesty.
about.quote: We believe the most beautiful skin is healthy, even skin — not perfect skin.

how.title: How to use
how.s1_d: Start with your usual amount of medical moisturizer in your palm.
how.s2_d: Add 2 to 5 drops of Eloria serum.
how.s3_d: Blend well between your hands until uniform.
how.s4_d: Massage onto the body in gentle circular motions.

routine.title: Discover your custom routine
routine.lead: Three quick questions and we'll design a routine for your skin.
routine.q1: How would you describe your skin?
routine.q3: When do you prefer to use it?
routine.drops_low: Start with just 2 drops in your cream — sensitive skin needs extra gentleness.
routine.drops_mid: Use 3 to 4 drops with your cream each time.
routine.drops_high: Use 5 drops with your cream to effectively target darker areas.
routine.p_cleanse: Cleanse the body with a gentle wash and pat dry.
routine.p_mix: Mix the serum drops with your moisturizer in your hand.
routine.p_apply: Spread the blend over the body in circular motions.
routine.p_spf: Finish your morning with SPF 50 sunscreen.
routine.p_knees: Focus an extra layer on knees and elbows.
routine.p_night: Repeat before bed for faster results.

final.title: Ready to even the look of your tone?
final.desc: A few drops added to your favorite cream each day — for a visibly more radiant, more even-looking complexion over time.
